scope.item: Hiring of Vehicles for Official Purpose at Cochin Directorate during the period April 2024 to March 2025

notes: Only Corrigendum II is in the listing; original tender and Corrigendum I not included, so vehicle types, numbers, cost and EMD are unknown. Extended dates printed as 30.04.2023, evidently a typo for 30.04.2024 (listing end date 2024-04-30); dates left null rather than guessed. Tender ID printed split across lines as '2024_DGLL_7 51730_1'. Signed by the Director (name printed).
